item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json; from work import evaluate; cases=[({'declared':['b','a','a','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','meta':{'z':1,'x':2}},'b':{'kind':'missing'},'extra':1},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'x':2,'z':1},'kind':'file'},'extra':2}}, {'ignored':['skip']}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}), ({'declared':['b','a','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'3'},'b':{'kind':'directory','entries':[]},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}}, {'ignored':['skip']}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','b']})];\\nfor req,pol,want in cases:\\n r0,p0=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert req==r0 and pol==p0\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]; print('ok')\"]}"}
